writeup: TIC 229181348 is a candidate eclipsing binary star system with an orbital period of 6.1209 days. Observations from TESS photometry show the primary eclipse produces a 13.08% dimming, while a secondary eclipse is detected at 6.5 sigma significance near orbital phase 0.49, suggesting both stars in the system eclipse each other from our viewpoint. The binary-search signal achieves a detection significance of 358.3 in signal-to-noise ratio, and pixel-level analysis confirms the signal with a peak signal-to-noise of 40.4, though the centroid offset of 1.9 arcseconds from the target warrants consideration. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a previously unknown system worthy of further study.
